entities.name: Aether
entities.description: An energy residing in the Blind Eternities; the raw magical power of creation, more volatile than mana.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The place between planes where aether resides.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane where aether shapes the natural world and fuels artificers' constructs; aetherborn are created there.

entities.name: Iquatana
entities.description: A plane whose atmosphere is mostly aether.

entities.name: Aetherdrift
entities.description: A blended space between aether and reality entered by filtering aerosolized aether into the body.
